title: Sources: the Pentagon quietly establishes the Technology Support Office (TSO), an agency to execute covert sabotage, cyberattacks, and supply chain disruptions (Politico)
summary: Politico: Sources: the Pentagon quietly establishes the Technology Support Office (TSO), an agency to execute covert sabotage, cyberattacks, and supply chain disruptions — The Pentagon has spent months quietly building an elite new tech agency to help covertly disrupt and sabotage foreign technology …
